statements.markdown: **Proposition B.14.** Let data of the form of Subsection B.1 be given, with the weights, bounds, matrices and numbers of Subsections B.2 to B.4, and suppose that they satisfy the conditions of this appendix. Then the set $\Gamma$, the set $\mathcal K$ of (7.29), the periods $S(\alpha)$, the fields $W_\alpha^{\mathrm a}$, $W^{\mathrm r}$, $b_i$, $F_\alpha^{\mathrm a}$, $\Xi_i$, $e_k$ and $\psi_j$, the maps $\beta^{\mathrm a}$ and $\bar\ell\equiv0$, the weight $w\equiv w_*$, the matrices $V$ and $Y$, and the numbers of the conditions are a certificate in the sense of Section 7.
